blindSummary: A 2025 facility ban; a statutory birth-sex definition. Listed by a July 2026 traveller-risk assessment in its most severe legislation category.
blindSourceSummaries: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (404 - the equality project has retired/moved this map entry); the underlying equality-map page carried the authoritative per-state list of bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities matching their gender identity, with the year each was enacted (the dossier's facility-ban years come from it). For this state/province it documents the 2025 facility ban, with the bill number cited in the project's own documents.

An independent traveller-risk assessment map for transgender visitors (July 2026; republished 27 Aug 2026 by a regional LGBTQ outlet), built from 5 years of daily legislative tracking with a severity rubric, lists this state/province among the jurisdictions whose laws most target transgender adults, and among those that prohibit any changes to birth certificates, forcing trans people to out themselves when showing documents. It also notes that federal policies keep creating legal difficulties for transgender people nationwide.
